title: Version 1.0
text: The first version of Nexus released to the public, the current version is built off this.

title: Version 1.1
text:
- You may now ban users that are not in the server, before you were only able to ban users in the server.
- New command: "myhistory", this will send a copy of your moderation history into your DMs.
- You can no longer use commands in DMs, only the "ping, commands, help" commands work there, all other commands must be preformed inside a server.
- New command: "Stats invite [Invite Code]" this will show details about an invite code linked to the server **You use it in,** from details such as the number of people that joined though it, to a graph with the join counts.

title: Version 1.1.1
text:
- To stop resource abuse, there is now a cooldown on using the same command (5 Seconds)
- New command: "Stats server" this command shows the total message of the whole server including voice hours
- New command: "Stats members" this shows the joins and leaves in the server with the net gain

title: Version 1.2
text:
- To ensure user privacy, you may now request for server data to be deleted permanently
  - Only the server owner can submit a data deletion request, requests take around 1-3 days to preform then all server data will be wiped
  - Use the new "wipe" command to submit a data request
- New command: "permission [command] [User, role, or permission]" This command now allows commands to have custom permissions for commands, using the command will add the subject to use the command though if you use it again the subject is removed from permission

title: Version 1.3
text:
- A completely new games system, complete revamp of the game system with new features and more.
  - Instead of 17 lower quality games, focus has been selected in 8 games: Blackjack, Tic-Tac-Toe, Hangman, Connect 4, Rock-Paper-Scissors, Trivia, Number Guess, and 2048.
  - Every game gives you a chance at playing either another person within the server or Nexus.
  - A completely new interface while using games, games will now be assisted with images when possible instead of the previous clutter with emojis

title: Version 1.3.1
text:
This version is focused on **bug fixes**, a quick polish on the bot. The following are the features and what bug are fixed in them. Minor bug fixes are not mentioned here, only the serious ones.
- Automoderation
  - Lockdowns are now saved in a database, if your server was in a lockdown it was saved in the bots memory. Now the lockdown is saved within a database which means it will remember even after shutdown.
  - Edited the scam link filter, now should be able to detect scam links more accurately then before. 
  -  Sometimes a message being deleted from being flagged as spam deleted other unrelated message, bot should now only delete messages that were in the spam. 
  - Some scammer may try to scam by editing their message in order to bypass the scam checking, Nexus now also checks edits
- Autoroles
  - The "role set" command would sometimes malfunction and fail to give you the set role, potential failure of the command is reduced now.
  - Setting a timed role twice with the same role would set 2 timers, now the new timer replaces any old ones.
- Information commands
  - Command "bannerinfo" now uses the same lookup process as other information commands, bannerinfo had it`s own system and crashed multiple times using it.
  - If your server had a large amount of roles, now command "rolelist" shows roles in pages. Pages max out up to 3 pages.
- Logging
  - When a user was kicked or banned, both the ban/kick and member leaving was logged, now the bot checks the audit log and if the user was kicked/banned it shows up as one log.
  - Limited max amount of characters in logging messages.
  - Ignored users still weren`t ignored in some areas, now ignored users should no longer be in any logging.
  - Switched all data to a database system instead of it being stored in memory
- Misc
  - If one giveaway failed, it stopped all giveaways, now the bot should only try to reset the one malfunctioning giveaway
  - Command "translate" used to block any other command from entering the bot, now the command runs on a separate thread
  - Command "say" can no log do role pings, only allows user mentions now

title: Version 1.4
text:
This update comes with a completely new website and systems, with now a dashboard
- User dashboard, accessible to all users
  - Provides basic information such as: activity statistics, active reminders, active giveaways, your command access and game statistics 
-  The Admin Dashboard: is meant for setting up server and Nexus’s features. Dashboard tabs:
  - General (Prefix, error log, and permissions editor)
  -  Moderation (Moderation settings, immune roles, case search, notes, and automod settings)
  - Tickets (Setup, ticket panel, and currently open tickets)
  - Logging (Logging channel and ignored users
  - Autoroles (Join roles, persistent roles, and timed roles)
  - Misc (Starboard and giveaways)

title: Version 1.4.1
text: - All commands are no longer just prefixes, all commands now are supported with slash commands

title: Version 1.4.2
text:
- New games: Word scramble, Minesweeper, and care battle
- Stats now have an option to choose the timeframe: 7d, 14d, 30d, 60d, 90d (d=Days)

title: Version 1.4.3
text:
- New AutoMod types: Emoji`s & Links.
- Errors that are logged in the dashboard are given an ID in the format of XXXX-XXXX, if you have questions about an error you have you can give an error code to support.
  - Timed roles command now show the time remaining on selected users timed roles.

title: Version 1.5
text:
- Removed all giveaway commands.
- Giveaways are now completely expanded.
  - Giveaways can only be setup up in the dashboard, full command support is now removed.
  - Setup entry requirements, such as: required roles, days in the server, days since account creation, and messages sent.
  - Choose to ping a role when your giveaway starts.
  - You may start a giveaway immediately or schedule when to start one.
- Maximum of 5 active giveaways at a time.

title: Version 1.6
text:
- New Honeypot feature apart of Automod. If you don`t know what a honeypot is: A honeypot is meant to ban off hacked accounts due to the bots controlling them will just send messages anywhere, a honeypot is meant to track a message sent in a trap channel and flag the account as a bot.
  - Only works in dashboard, no command support.
  - Setup a honeypot channel where Nexus takes care of everything, do an easy setup and ban anyone who types in your channel will become banned.
- Multiple bug fixes for tickets.
- Dashboard changes: Personal dashboard is now in one central area with all the same dashboard tools, option to filter results to a certain server if you would like to.
- Removed direct support, no longer a feature.
